summary: Frontend-only scoped testing completed for push token registration hardening via code-path review plus unauthenticated Expo web runtime checks. Auth-gated registration, retry safety, logout unregister path, and token-refresh guard are present in code; no new boot/sign-in regressions were observed.

integration_issues.flow: Privacy screen data query in unauthenticated web preview
integration_issues.issue: Console shows repeated Convex server error for privacy:getSettings query while route still renders; likely missing graceful unauth fallback or backend-side guard handling for this query path.
Could not fully validate real mobilePushTokens persistence because this run had no authenticated native-device session; verification limited to static code-path review and web preview runtime.

action_items: Run authenticated Android native-device test and confirm successful api.mobilePush.registerMobileDevice mutation followed by token presence in backend mobilePushTokens.
Force token rotation on Android (FCM refresh) and verify addPushTokenListener path re-registers only after Convex auth readiness.
Perform logout on native after successful registration and confirm unregister mutation actually removes token server-side.
Investigate/handle privacy:getSettings Convex server error observed in unauth web preview to reduce noisy failure logs.
critical_code_review_comments: Push registration is now correctly gated by both app auth and Convex auth readiness: hasAuthSession && isConvexAuthenticated && !isConvexAuthLoading.
Registration retry logic is safe: retry timer is tracked/cleared via registrationRetryTimer ref and clearRegistrationRetry callback; no broken variable reference found in retry path.
Token refresh listener now uses canRegisterWithBackend guard and no stale isAuthenticated identifier usage was found.
Logout unregister path still exists: when auth session becomes false and cached token exists, unregisterDeviceWithBackend(...) is called best-effort then local token cache is cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file exists at /app/memory/test_credentials.md, but this run intentionally stayed unauthenticated/native-device-less per request constraints. Web shim usePushNotifications.web.ts remains no-op, so push token execution paths cannot be runtime-validated in web preview.
rca_of_issue: Root-cause hypothesis from agent context is consistent with current code: prior early registration before Convex auth readiness could fail mutation and miss token persistence. Current hook introduces Convex auth gate + retry + active-state re-registration + guarded token refresh listener, which removes the prior obvious race path. Remaining gap is real-device authenticated confirmation. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
